assessmentPolicy: Assistant proposals are advisory. They never replace user ratings, triage, creative lane, design stage, component locks or reference selection. The user may adopt or revise a proposal using the existing rating control.
standardPriority: Full-face anchor establishes identity; newer scoped dental and tattoo anchors establish their specific details. Jewelry tolerance is recorded in character_head_reference_standard.txt.

rubric.5: Visible defining features closely match the appropriate gold-standard anchors, with no material mismatch.
rubric.4: Close visible match, with small deviations or bounded detail uncertainty.
rubric.3: Recognizable character direction, with a material mapping problem or approximate identity.
rubric.2: Substantial mismatch in multiple defining visible features.
rubric.1: The visible character largely departs from the approved identity.
rubric.unrated: Too few defining features are visible to make a likeness judgment.

coveragePolicy: Occluded features are not failed features. Confidence and visibility limits must accompany a score; no unseen anatomy, dental material or articulation is inferred.
